\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-06},
  title = {Success criteria for the price model},
  date = {2026-09-22},
  milestone = {M1: Project Inception},
  topic = {Performance Criteria},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {A model is deployable when it meets SC-01 to SC-05 on the seller-grouped test set: MdAPE at most 9\,\%, at least 85\,\% of predictions within \ensuremath{\pm}20\,\%, MdAPE at least 30\,\% below the median baseline, MdAPE at most 15\,\% in every segment level with 500 or more test rows, and 88\,\% to 92\,\% coverage of the nominal 90\,\% intervals.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Baseline comparison only: says nothing about usefulness, and a weak baseline makes it easy to pass.
\item MAPE-based targets: dominated by cheap cars and outliers.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} The thresholds come from an exploratory run on 96,831 listings, where the median baseline reached 11.9\,\% MdAPE and an untuned LightGBM 6.7\,\%.
They leave a margin, so they hold across splits and still rule out a model barely better than the baseline.
Price buckets are excluded from the segments because they condition on the target.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI ran the exploratory models and proposed the criteria with their thresholds.
Lukas accepted because the thresholds are tied to measured values.
AI's segment check then showed SC-04 missed for cars older than 20 years; we kept the criterion and documented the gap (EDN-62).},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-09-22 on issue \#2; prompt: ``Which kind of success criteria?''.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/problem-spec.md}{Problem specification} sections 6 to 8, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/2}{issue \#2}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/17}{PR \#17}.},
